The batch therefore shifts away from generic pure-EA donor controls toward intermediate condition curves, high-retention carbonyl regions, and matched nitrogen and loading contrasts.","batch_rationale":"The batch repairs the strongest current failure regions while preserving chemically meaningful local controls. Four m200/m205 measurements extend donor-containing solvent and loading curves after the new labels showed large but scaffold-specific responses. Four m177/m32 measurements address unresolved loading and reproducibility behavior without imposing a smooth law. Ether acetoacetates, beta-ketoesters, esters and aromatic carbonyls receive intermediate or weak-eluent points because their measured curves contain large endpoint errors and opposite signed deviations within related families. The m125, m118, m129 and m178 choices target high-uncertainty aromatic carbonyl extrapolation. Amino nitrile isomers, amino ester, dibenzylamine and oxime measurements distinguish nitrogen environments and positional effects. A small number of neutral controls test whether the rejected pure-EA artifact is confined to donor-containing molecules. The batch has deliberate local redundancy where it tests response surfaces, while covering recurring chemical families and loading regimes that can improve overall V1/V2 accuracy across the Row distribution."}
